top_choice_rationale: P004 credits a physical-chemical principle, demixing of multivalent biomolecules above a saturation concentration into dense liquid phases, established quantitatively in reconstituted systems (Brangwynne and Hyman 2009, Rosen 2012) and reproduced widely. The citation is narrow and does not require every in vivo condensate to be liquid. Attribution (Pappu, Mittag) and the Medicine overlap are real weaknesses, so P001, the next most principled and well-validated proposal, follows closely. P002 is mature but its category and priority picture are less clear, P003 adds a younger base-editing part with a contested allocation, and no award ranks last.
